summary: First-round comprehensive testing of Interview Prep MVP. Backend: 19/19 pytest tests passed (domains, questions, auth, JWT cookies, admin analytics, domain CRUD, question CRUD, search, AI chat with GPT-5.2). Frontend: homepage with 6 domain cards, search, domain page with all 4 difficulty filters + most-asked, accordion with syntax-highlighted code, AI chat drawer opening with context, theme cycling (Light/Dark/Warm), admin login flow, admin analytics cards, tab switching, and Add Domain button - all verified working. No critical issues found.

minor.issue: Returns 401 on every page load when not logged in (expected, but generates console.error noise in browser) - consider catching silently in AuthContext

action_items: Optional: silence 401 console errors on /api/auth/me by handling them quietly in AuthContext (not a bug, but cleaner UX in DevTools)
Minor: consistent data-testid naming - Header uses 'theme-toggle-btn' (works, but request spec mentioned just 'theme-toggle'). Confirmed working.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 449 lines, single file - acceptable for MVP but should be split into routers (auth, domains, questions, admin, chat) as it grows beyond 700 lines

AI chat endpoint replays user history by calling chat.send_message in a loop for context - this incurs unnecessary LLM cost and latency; consider passing history through system message or LlmChat history param instead
create_domain returns doc with internal _id stripped via pop after insert (OK), but inserted timestamp uses isoformat string - consistent with seed data
CORS_ORIGINS uses split(',') with no strip, so any whitespace in env breaks matching - minor robustness issue
No rate limiting / brute force lockout on /api/auth/login (playbook mentions 5-fail lockout). Currently absent - acceptable for MVP but should be added before production
seed_data_creation: Backend seeds 6 domains and 13 questions on startup. Test data prefixed TEST_ was created and cleaned up successfully.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All MVP features verified working end-to-end. Backend test suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py is reusable for regression. Admin login uses httpOnly cookies via /api/auth/login with credentials. Theme toggle is at [data-testid='theme-toggle-btn']. AI chat drawer opens with [data-testid='ai-chat-drawer']. Frontend uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL with /api prefix correctly. No bugs to fix.
